snippet.title: ‘Save My Scrap’ Coming to Steam and consoles in 2026!
snippet.description:
“Save My Scrap” is based on the free game “Fix My Junk.”, developed by Unio Anou, which gained popularity in Japan for its decadent and beautiful pixel art and its heart-wrenching story. 
This time, AMATA Games has acquired the publishing rights for this game.
It will be released as a significantly upgraded version, now titled "Save My Scrap." This version includes additional dialogue and endings written by Unio Anno himself, the addition of a gallery mode, support for game controllers, and a more comfortable play experience achieved through a change in the game engine. It can be considered a definitive edition.

■AMATA Games “Save My Scrap” page
https://amata.games/en/game/savemyscrap/

■Steam Store Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078210/Save_My_Scrap/
